Calea Girocului este zona din sudul Timi: Calea Girocului is the southern area of Timișoara connecting the city to the Giroc commune. It combines 1980s apartment blocks with recent residential developments built towards the administrative border, and prices per square meter are below the city average. It is sought after by young families looking for new housing on a moderate budget, with quick access to the County Hospital and the south of the city.
Calea Girocului leagă zona direct de cen: Calea Girocului connects the area directly to the center (12–15 minutes by car) and to the ring road towards the south of the city. Public transport covers the urban section, with good frequency in the segment near the hospital.
Calea Lipovei are caracterul unui cartie: Calea Lipovei has the character of a classic residential neighborhood: apartment blocks arranged in complexes with green spaces between them, inner walkways, small shops on the ground floor, and a predictable neighborhood life. It is not a destination area — people come here because they live here, not to visit.
Calea Lipovei oferă cele mai accesibile: Calea Lipovei offers the most affordable prices in Timișoara (1,550 €/sqm) because it is an area undergoing modernization, with high potential for medium-term appreciation.
Calea Șagului este axa sud-vestică a Tim: Calea Șagului is the southwestern axis of Timișoara, oriented towards the industrial and logistics parks at the exit towards Șag and Moravița. The housing stock is dominated by 1970s–1980s apartment buildings, with new residential developments interspersed, and prices per square meter are below the city average. Rental demand comes primarily from production, logistics, and retail employees working nearby.
Calea Șagului este o zonă de locuit strâ: Calea Șagului is a residential area closely linked to the city's real economy: along its axis lies a significant portion of Timișoara's industrial and logistics hubs, plus large-scale retail. This gives it a practical character — less spectacular than Cetate or ISHO, but with a clear function.
